bio.text: Jessie McGruder is serving his first term in the Arkansas House, representing District 35, which includes portions of Crittenden and Cross counties.
He is an educator who coaches football, basketball and track at Wonder Jr High School in West Memphis, and he lives in Marion.
He is a graduate of Arkansas State University and is earning a master's degree in education from the University of Arkansas at Pine Bluff.
